ctx.x: I don't know if they had any type of recording equipment around Jackson during that time. Because during that period, everybody had to go to Chicago to record. I remember the legendary Little Brother Montgomery used to play house parties at my house, and my grandfather played with him... He was Paul Gayten's uncle.
